records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2025
records.text: Consolidated net sales for the third quarter of 2025 totaled $303.3 million, a 4.0% decrease as compared to consolidated net sales of $315.8 million in the third quarter of 2024.

records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2025
records.text: •Organic sales decline of 5.4% primarily due to volume declines in North America, which lapped a significant backlog-reduction benefit in the prior-year period, partly offset by price realization; and

records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2025
records.text: Previously implemented U.S. tariffs and related actions have begun to increase input costs, disrupt supply chains, and affect customer demand as end users absorb higher costs.

records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2025
records.text: Slower global growth and the uncertain effects of higher tariffs on our international and domestic trade are forcing us to aggressively manage our margins.

records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2025
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities during the nine months ended September 30, 2025 was $50.8 million compared to net cash provided by operating activities of $52.2 million during the nine months ended September 30, 2024.
